meta.description: Trim multiple sequence alignments using ClipKIT, trimAl, BMGE, Divvier, or HMMcleaner with mode selection guidance per downstream goal. Use when removing unreliable columns or contaminating residues before phylogenetic inference, HMM building, or selection analysis.
meta.executed: 9/9 inputs executed (ClipKIT 2.14.0, trimAl 1.4.1, BMGE 1.12 and 2.0, MACSE 2.07, PAML 4.10.10 codeml, PhyIN 1.0, IQ-TREE 2.4.0); T-Coffee, HMMcleaner, Divvier, Gblocks and hmmbuild not executable on Windows
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs re-run as regression tests (runs_v2/in1-in7) plus 2 new inputs (in8 PhyIN, in9 sequence-overlap filtering); N = 9. Skill commands and parsers used verbatim (helpers.py marks the copied code). SYNTHETIC data from data/make_data.py.

scientific_integrity.detail: All numbers come from runs on synthetic alignments with known trees; the fixed Skill dropped the unverifiable ClipKIT issue citations.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research alignment processing only; no individual-level content.

methodological_ground.detail: Outputs kept trimmed-vs-untrimmed sensitivity trees, refused support-driven over-trimming and did not column-trim branch-site input.

code_usability.detail: Every executable Skill command ran on the documented versions: ClipKIT -of phylip, both BMGE syntaxes with the test -s guard, the trimAl and ClipKIT column-map parsers, MACSE export and sed cleanup, PhyIN, trimAl -resoverlap/-seqoverlap; all four examples pass py_compile and clipkit_trim.py/bmge_trim.py run on both BMGE versions.

functional_suitability.note: Most pre-fix flag errors corrected and verified (ClipKIT -of, BMGE 1.12/2.0 table, PhyIN, MACSE export, codeml '!', column-map formats). Remaining: the goal table still calls BMGE 'Entropy-based with BLOSUM62 context' (BLOSUM30 on 2.0) and the first-line phylogenetics sentence offers trimAl -automated1 while a later note says not to use it for audit-grade work; T-Coffee/HMMcleaner/Gblocks/Divvier lines are documentation-checked only.

reliability.note: BMGE output check, concatenation-charset and codeml rows added and accurate; no caution that trimAl -resoverlap/-seqoverlap can drop full-length sequences (Input 9).

performance_context.note: 330-line monolithic SKILL.md; TCS, MACSE, PhyIN, Gblocks detail all inline.

agent_usability.note: One 20%/40% rule, scoped to gap/entropy modes, consistent across SKILL.md, usage guide and clipkit_trim.py. Small mixed messages remain (-automated1, BLOSUM62).

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in usage guide; description names tools more than tasks.

security.note: Local tools, list-form subprocess; no alignment-type validation.

maintainability.note: Examples updated with version switch and output check and run; no test data or expected outputs.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, good do-not-trim escape hatches for selection analysis and short genes; progressive disclosure 2 (monolithic).

recommendations.title: Caution on trimAl sequence-overlap thresholds
recommendations.problem: -resoverlap 0.8 -seqoverlap 75 dropped two full-length sequences along with the fragments, silently.
recommendations.root_cause: The flags are listed without guidance on thresholds or on checking removed sequences.
recommendations.fix: Say the thresholds are dataset-dependent, list removed sequence names (diff headers) and relax -seqoverlap when full-length sequences are lost.

recommendations.title: Remove the remaining mixed messages
recommendations.problem: BMGE is described with BLOSUM62 context (BLOSUM30 on 2.0), and trimAl -automated1 is offered for publication-grade trimming while the reproducibility note says not to use it for audit-grade work.
recommendations.root_cause: Older sentences were not reconciled with the fixed sections.
recommendations.fix: Say 'substitution-matrix entropy (BLOSUM62 in 1.12, BLOSUM30 in 2.0)' and name an explicit trimAl mode in the first-line sentence.
